5:   def pbReduceHP(amt, anim = true, registerDamage = true, anyAnim = true)
6:     amt = amt.round
7:     amt = @hp if amt > @hp
8:     amt = 1 if amt < 1 && !fainted?
9:     oldHP = @hp
10:     self.hp -= amt
11:     PBDebug.log("[HP change] #{pbThis} lost #{amt} HP (#{oldHP} -> #{@hp})") if amt > 0
12:     raise _INTL("HP less than 0") if @hp < 0
13:     raise _INTL("HP greater than total HP") if @hp > @totalhp
14:     @battle.scene.pbHPChanged(self, oldHP, anim) if anyAnim && amt > 0
15:     if amt > 0 && registerDamage
16:       @droppedBelowHalfHP = true if @hp < @totalhp / 2 && @hp + amt >= @totalhp / 2
17:       @tookDamageThisRound = true
18:       @tookMoveDamageThisRound = true
19:     end
20:     return amt
21:   end

23:   def pbRecoverHP(amt, anim = true, anyAnim = true)
24:     amt = amt.round
25:     amt = @totalhp - @hp if amt > @totalhp - @hp
26:     amt = 1 if amt < 1 && @hp < @totalhp
27:     oldHP = @hp
28:     self.hp += amt
29:     PBDebug.log("[HP change] #{pbThis} gained #{amt} HP (#{oldHP} -> #{@hp})") if amt > 0
30:     raise _INTL("HP less than 0") if @hp < 0
31:     raise _INTL("HP greater than total HP") if @hp > @totalhp
32:     @battle.scene.pbHPChanged(self, oldHP, anim) if anyAnim && amt > 0
33:     @droppedBelowHalfHP = false if @hp >= @totalhp / 2
34:     return amt
35:   end

189:   def pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange(ability_changed = false)
190:     return if fainted? || @effects[PBEffects::Transform]
191:     # Castform - Forecast
192:     if isSpecies?(:CASTFORM)
193:       if hasActiveAbility?(:FORECAST)
194:         newForm = 0
195:         case effectiveWeather
196:         when :Sun, :HarshSun   then newForm = 1
197:         when :Rain, :HeavyRain then newForm = 2
198:         when :Hail             then newForm = 3
199:         end
200:         if @form != newForm
201:           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
202:           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
203:           pbChangeForm(newForm, _INTL("{1} transformed!", pbThis))
204:         end
205:       else
206:         pbChangeForm(0, _INTL("{1} transformed!", pbThis))
207:       end
208:     end
209:     # Cherrim - Flower Gift
210:     if isSpecies?(:CHERRIM)
211:       if hasActiveAbility?(:FLOWERGIFT)
212:         newForm = 0
213:         newForm = 1 if [:Sun, :HarshSun].include?(effectiveWeather)
214:         if @form != newForm
215:           @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(self, true)
216:           @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(self)
217:           pbChangeForm(newForm, _INTL("{1} transformed!", pbThis))
218:         end
219:       else
220:         pbChangeForm(0, _INTL("{1} transformed!", pbThis))
221:       end
222:     end
223:     # Eiscue - Ice Face
224:     if !ability_changed && isSpecies?(:EISCUE) && self.ability == :ICEFACE &&
225:        @form == 1 && effectiveWeather == :Hail
226:       @canRestoreIceFace = true   # Changed form at end of round
227:     end
228:   end
